GDP: look at a real world country similar to yours and adjust it reasonably.

GDP per capita: GDP ÷ Population

[quote=the_greater_ottomans;60823403]how do i know my GDP per capita and GDP?[/quote]
Well, when you fill out the "joining" template/telegram to "Cordone Roleplay Bureau" you make that up according to the rules, I belive its someting like this:
Max starting population: 100 million
Max starting GDP: up to, but not exactly 1 Trillion
You then use the numbers you go for to find your 'GDP per capita' wich is basicly GDP devided by your population.
This basicly means that if you have a high population you will get a low 'GDP per capita' while if you have a small population it will be high.

Joust so you know, we don't use the stats of NationStates as they get all kind of wonky real fast, so your nation dosen't need to be anyting like  your NS one.

Btw, when chosing what continent to start on remember to align your culture and/or history with it, the higher ups want stuff to make sence to a seartain degree :O

[quote=dhornaper;60823811]Napoleon called his empire the French Republic.[/quote]
He later renamed it to the French Empire in 1808,

Additionally, that was largely formal; the First French Republic died when he proclaimed himself Emperor, and most began calling it the French Empire before its official renaming in 1808.

Also, France is weird; people didn't really see Napoleon as a monarch in the traditional sense, it's an exception, not a rule
